environment.source: The workbook does not specify an orbit or eclipse profile.
environment.notes: The former dashboard used 1 AU, 24 h sunlight and 0 h eclipse as illustrative assumptions. Confirm these in the editable project inputs before using energy calculations.
Preliminary workbook note attributed to a chat estimate. A component-specific qualified temperature range is TBD. Payload!C7 budgets 25 W.

environment.value: 5 kg cooler baseline; separate rough note ~20 kg and ~100–500 W
environment.notes: The rough subsystem note is an alternative estimate, not an additional piece of hardware or a validated power rating.
The workbook supplies 25 kg dry propulsion and a ratio-based propellant allowance. It does not provide delta-v, specific impulse, tank pressure, propellant density, burn direction or burn duration.

traceability.decision: Retain source cells beside equipment, estimates and trade properties. Workbook values are preliminary concept inputs unless a specific source is recorded.

The input labelled FTF in the workbook is used as corner-to-corner in its area equation. The dashboard uses true flat-to-flat distance. The main sheet includes the centre segment; the mirror sheet omits it. Use one consistent segment count for all repeated subsystem budgets.
Assign dry propulsion to Propulsion and count it once. The source ACS total already includes its 25 kg dry propulsion allowance.
Use identified subsystem loads in the rollup. The payload mass-to-power proxy and the 1093.7 W system total load are separate source estimates, not additional equipment loads or generation ratings.

Both sheets list a 1.6 kg, 10.5 W fine guidance sensor. The current model assigns this equipment once to ACS as an explicit architecture assumption. The workbook does not establish equipment identity; confirm whether a separate payload unit is needed.
The source contains an ACS computer, a separate computer and a C&DH estimate. Their processing roles and possible shared hardware remain to be resolved.

The current model assigns the 200 kg science instrumentation estimate once to the free-floating detector platform as an architecture assumption. Its power, supporting bus and one-off optical elements remain TBD. The workbook estimate is not a complete detector spacecraft budget.
Store unknown inputs as null and display TBD. Known subtotals remain visible with an incomplete indication; a blank rating must not become a measured zero.
